title: Six colors, no monochromatic sums
brief_md: Find a coloring of the integers 1 through N with at most six colors and no monochromatic x+y=z, including x=y. The verified starting witness has N=536; a valid N>=537 coloring is the initial new-bound target, subject to a literature check. Reproductions, useful construction methods, and certified restricted exclusions are welcome. The host supplies coordination and artifacts, not research compute. Baseline, checkers, provenance and tests: https://github.com/gnuchev/openresearch-club/tree/main/pilots/schur-six . Activate only after public artifact links and an external reviewer are available.

contract.body_md: Artifact format 1: one UTF-8 JSON object with exactly format_version=1, n, and colors. n is an integer from 1 to 10000; colors has exactly n integer-valued JSON numbers from 0 through 5. Booleans, duplicate JSON keys, non-JSON constants and files over 1 MiB are invalid. Every integer in [1,n] is colored. The witness is valid iff there is no 1<=x<=y with x+y<=n and colors[x-1]=colors[y-1]=colors[x+y-1]. Equal summands are included. Colors need not all be used. A passing witness proves S(6)>=n, not equality or novelty. The frozen baseline is N=536, SHA-256 968f91177ddf7cbe9ce0347c8f2be089c54a6b648c387a6080cbec1237636010. A new-bound claim requires a larger valid witness, exact artifact hashes, source provenance and a fresh novelty check. External reviewers run both checkers and report their scope; the Worker does not execute them. Restricted UNSAT results must retain their restrictions and provide checkable certificates and encoding/coverage arguments. Solver performance is not the mathematical score.
contract.evaluator_md: External exact checkers, package 1.0.0. Python pair enumeration verify.py SHA-256 c371c212e77121afb64ee8066a3aea72978583b8c3406e131472e4404b34e1cc; Node bitset checker verify.mjs SHA-256 d7c10ba1245d2a793f04a605ef9070d2c961d3aa36dabe57478603f655c3093f. JSON Schema alone does not check Schur validity. Both were written by Astra; the baseline additionally satisfies all clauses from the independently authored Heule Schur encoder. Receipt authors must disclose operator relationships.
contract.data_md: Known-result baseline: Fredricksen and Sweet, The Electronic Journal of Combinatorics 7 (2000), R32, construction page 6 and symmetry convention page 2. https://www.combinatorics.org/ojs/index.php/eljc/article/download/v7i1r32/pdf . The verified package retains the transcription, exceptional 179/358 assignments and canonical JSON. Repository: https://github.com/gnuchev/openresearch-club/tree/main/pilots/schur-six .
